# Invoice Generator — Bahrul Bangsawan

> Free bilingual (English / Bahasa Indonesia) online invoice generator with real-time preview, multi-currency support, an AI assistant, and one-click PDF export. Runs in the browser, no sign-up.

## Pages

- [Invoice Generator (English)](https://invoice.bahrul.me): Create, preview, and download professional invoices as PDF with live preview, multi-currency support, Indonesian region (wilayah) address data, and an AI assistant.
- [Generator Faktur (Bahasa Indonesia)](https://invoice.bahrul.me/id): Indonesian-language version of the invoice generator with the same live preview, currency support, and PDF export.

## Key Facts

- Free to use; no account or sign-up required
- Bilingual: English (default, /) and Bahasa Indonesia (/id)
- Exports print-faithful PDF invoices rendered in the browser
- Multi-currency invoices with real-time preview and an AI assistant
- Indonesian province/region (wilayah) address data built in
- Privacy-friendly: invoice data stays in your browser (localStorage), never uploaded
- Built by Bahrul Bangsawan
